messages:
micah: CI just went red on master right after the deps bump (PR #3249). Failing consistently in allocator tests on linux. Can someone pick this up for a quick bisect?
ci-bot: pipeline https://ci.internal/pipelines/789 - stage: unit-tests - status: failed
ci-bot: failing test: tests/allocator/test_shard_alloc.py::test_shard_rebalance - exit code 1
ci-bot: recent change: merge commit 45b3c2 (PR #3249) bumped protobuf 4.25 -> 4.26
tara: on it. did you try a rerun? flaky? :eyes:
micah: reran once, failed again. last green was commit abcdef1 (2026-03-15T21:12:03Z). suspect is the deps bump in #3249 but want to bisect to be sure.
sahil: I can run a bisect. can we reproduce locally with the same docker image? what exact pytest command?
rachel: I pushed a reproducer image to gcr: gcr.io/redwood-ci/allocator-repro:20260316 - it runs the unit tests under ubuntu:22.04. link: https://gcr.io/redwood-ci/allocator-repro
deniz: note: there's also a scheduler tweak in PR #3253 landing later that might interact, but that merged after #3249 so less likely.
tara: plan: 1) bisect between abcdef1 (good) and HEAD (bad). 2) use a small script to run only the failing test to save time. 3) if bisect points to the deps bump, revert or pin.
tara: bisect commands I'm using:
```
git checkout abcdef1
git bisect start HEAD abcdef1
# on each step we run the repro container and run the test
./ci/run_in_repro.sh pytest tests/allocator/test_shard_alloc.py::test_shard_rebalance -q
# then git bisect good/bad
```
micah: thanks. @tara ping me if you narrow it down to a single merge. I can open a revert and coordinate the emergency patch.
tara: bisect started. first few steps complete, reproduces at several points. narrowing...
 tara: update: narrowed to commit 45b3c2 (merge of PR #3249). locally switching back to protobuf==4.25 makes the test pass. with 4.26 it fails consistently.
sanjay: confirmed I authored #3249 (protobuf bump). happy to help with a quick revert or a targeted fix.
sahil: can we try pinning protobuf==4.25 in the constraints and run full unit suite in the repro image?
rachel: just ran a quick full run in repro with protobuf pinned -> unit suite passed locally. pushed a constraints patch to sandbag branch: https://phabricator/internal/D12345 (temp pin).
ci-bot: pipeline https://ci.internal/pipelines/790 - status: running (using pin-protobuf branch)
micah: ok let's do the revert PR and hotfix pin while we investigate root cause (protobuf API change?). @sanjay can you lead the revert?
sanjay: will open revert PR in next 10m, will add note to changelog and follow up with deeper investigation.
tara: final check: after pin PR merged to sandbag, CI rerun passed on the repro image. looks safe as a hotfix.
ci-bot: pipeline https://ci.internal/pipelines/790 - status: passed :tada:
micah: thanks everyone. follow-up actions: (1) revert PR #3249, (2) add integration test for serializer behavior changed in protobuf 4.26, (3) postmortem if we find API break. I'll file the follow-up tasks.
micah: closing here, re-open if anyone sees regressions after revert.
